description.value: Rocky Point Ice Cream started as a small scoop shack at Rocky Point Park in Port Moody in 1997 and has grown into a beloved multi-location artisan ice cream brand — operating BC's first licensed dairy plant dedicated exclusively to craft ice cream production. The original Port Moody location sits right in Rocky Point Park, making it a natural and satisfying stop for cyclists on the area's waterfront trails. All ice cream is handcrafted from scratch, with rotating seasonal flavours and a permanent selection that includes plant-based options.
